title: Why esports is your next growth engine
summary: Esports fans are already betting on their favourite games. Why are you missing out?
body_markdown:
*Esports fans are already betting on their favourite games. Why are you missing out?*


**A market that has stopped being niche**


The esports betting market generated $2.8bn in gross gaming revenue for licensed operators in 2025. These results have been fuelled by the popularity of major titles – Counter-Strike 2 alone accounted for 57% of full-year 2025 wagering. League of Legends took 27%. But the market is not limited to established titles, with Valorant’s betting volume growing 175% year over year since Riot Games partnered with GRID to first introduce its official data to the betting market in 2023.


The audience explains why. 640 million people watched esports last year. Most are under 30, mobile-first, and stats hungry – the exact profile sportsbooks aim to attract, but also the pickiest demographic to convince.


The demand is there, and now we make meeting it easy.
